user.title: Connect to WealthyExile
user.description: Log in at wealthyexile.com/stash, open your browser's DevTools (Network tab), pick a request to `stash?primary=true`, and look at its `cookie` header. You're looking for the cookie that starts with `session-` — e.g. `session-Allflame-1=eyJhbGci...`. Enter its name (the part before `=`) and value (everything after) below. Important: the name changes with every new PoE league (e.g. `session-Allflame-1` eventually becomes `session-<NewLeague>-1`) — always enter the current name, not an old one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach WealthyExile. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.parse_failed: Could not read WealthyExile's response — either the cookie is invalid/expired, or WealthyExile updated their site's page structure.

stash_parse_failed.title: WealthyExile response could not be read, repeatedly
stash_parse_failed.description: A single failure is normal (e.g. a brief network hiccup) and self-heals on the next poll — this message only appears after several consecutive failures. Most likely cause: your stored cookie has expired. Set up the integration again with a fresh cookie from wealthyexile.com/stash. If that doesn't help, WealthyExile may have changed their page structure in a way this integration doesn't handle yet.
